question:
Choose the correct meaning of the given idiom/phrase from the options:
"A dime a dozen"
solution:
The correct answer is: **4 i.e. Very common**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"A dime a dozen"** means something that is very common and easy to find. (बहुत आम)
 
 
• **Example:** Smartphones are a dime a dozen these days; everyone has one.
 
 
• **"Very common"** refers to something that occurs frequently or is widely available. (बहुत आम)
 
 
• **Example:** Fast food restaurants are very common in urban areas.
 
 
• Hence, the correct meaning of the idiom "A dime a dozen" is **"Very common."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **4 i.e. Very common**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **1) Very rare** (बहुत दुर्लभ): Refers to something that is uncommon or hard to find.
 
 
• **Example:** Finding a four-leaf clover is very rare.
 
 
 
• **2) Extremely expensive** (बहुत महंगा): Refers to something that costs a significant amount of money.
 
 
• **Example:** That diamond necklace is extremely expensive.
 
 
 
• **3) Hard to find** (खोजना कठिन): Refers to something that is not easily available or accessible.
 
 
• **Example:** A good mechanic in this area is hard to find.
 
 

c1:T7bc,

The correct answer is **Option 1**.
